product.bounds: Every actual seek normalizes at the Video media owner to 0..current longest known channel duration. Unknown duration clamps to zero; later metadata never revives an oversized previous request.
product.projection: Latest-only owned status wake publishes the same runtime range used by the generic Inspector. Shrinking duration clamps its live value without authoring a seek. Feedback publication sequence rejects older metadata and unchanged status still avoids another wake.
product.history: Manual seeks and frame steps change runtime state without saved values or undo entries. Authored Speed undo/redo preserves the stepped position; commands keep their authored Position argument while execution clamps the shared runtime.
product.callers: Generic Parameter intents, typed Video edits, seekVideo operation/real QuickJS calls, Seek and Step commands all use the shared owner. Identical seeks remain real intents without a separate operation-adapter replay path.
product.schema: Media v11; Command v8. Previous media schemas, retired Seek To fields and saved nonzero Current Position are rejected. No backward migration is supplied.
